title: Origin story: Artemis
description: Artemis was the twin sister of Apollo, daughter of Zeus and Leto, born on Delos. She asked her father for eternal maidenhood, a silver bow, and dominion over the wilds, and received all three. She guarded young creatures and punished oath-breakers, most famously turning the hunter Actaeon into a stag for seeing her bathe.
